tmp:1064: hasagat ha-Torah — the attainment/comprehension of Torah, the cognitive grasp of Torah merited upon reaching the level of Da'at (Proverbs 8:12, Daniel 2:21)
tmp:1065: bittul she-nitbatel el ha-takhlit — the state of self-nullification in which one is absorbed into the ultimate End/purpose (God), reached through suffering, whose residual reshimu yields Torah innovations
tmp:1066: the attainment, within nullification to the End, of the insight that all sufferings are actually very great goods — the perception consoling one over afflictions
tmp:1068: matar — rain as a symbol: the downflow of divine bounty and blessings prepared through controversy for the sake of Heaven
tmp:1069: hashpa'ot u-verakhot — divine effluences and blessings, the bounty symbolized by rain (matar)
tmp:1070: hit'havut ha-nefesh — the coming-into-being/formation of a soul, generated by a Jew's yearning and longing for God (Psalms 84: 'my soul yearns')
tmp:1071: al yedei ha-ahavah — 'through love': love (chesed, right side, Abraham) as the agent by which empowerment/overcoming occurs ('many waters cannot extinguish the love')
tmp:1072: hitgabrut — empowerment/prevailing, the strengthening (gevurah-overcoming) whose main source is love, per 'Sit at My right hand'
tmp:1073: the kabbalistic act of combining the gevurot (severities, left) within the chasadim (kindnesses, right) — 'left within the right' (Psalms 20:7)
tmp:1075: 'in the perfection of deeds and the refinement of the intellect' — the pair of matter (instruments of action) and form (intellect, 'father in wisdom') on which one's spiritual money depends
tmp:1076: Song of Songs 5:4 'My beloved sent his hand through the opening' — proof-verse for the revelation of the illumination of the hands (clapping in prayer that nullifies idolatry)
tmp:1079: hitgalut ha-hitpa'arut — the revelation of the King's glory/adornment (splendid garments on the royal celebration day), identified with the revelation of fear, which leads to revelation of the will/love
tmp:1084: mal'akhei libo — 'the angels/messengers of his heart', the flaming enthusiasm (hitlahavut) of the heart within the heart-Temple, vulnerable to the external forces
tmp:1086: tenu'at ha-sekhel — the movement/motion of the intellect, which by the heat-generating nature of motion gives birth to the heart's enthusiasm
tmp:1088: the practice of recounting before the Torah scholar — viduy devarim, verbal confession of sins spoken before the talmid chakham, remedy for the bad traits of the four elements
tmp:1089: the principle that the disciples receive 'double' (pi shenayim) of the master's spirit at the tzaddik's passing (Elisha-Elijah model), the great illumination revealed at histalkut
tmp:1090: anafim — 'branches' of the wife's soul-tree: the sparkling and spreading of her soul's light, symbolizing the money allotted to a man with his spouse
tmp:1092: the awakening/arousal of Chokhmah (Wisdom) that occurs in prayer — 'creation in potential', the renewal of the world before it emerges into actuality in Torah
tmp:1093: the drawing near of Israel to their Father in Heaven — the closeness achieved chiefly through tikkun ha-brit ('I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to Me')
tmp:1094: hatarah/hasibah of eating — 'Vayasev' read as reclining at a meal (Midrash Shemot 20): the festive-meal sense of God 'leading around' Israel, linked to the five mouth-articulations
tmp:1095: 'and then God's right hand is outstretched to receive his repentance' — the divine acceptance attained via the two expertises (baki in ascent/descent, KS"A and S"G) forming the derekh of teshuvah
tmp:1097: madregah tachtonah me'od — the very lowest spiritual rung, where one must still believe God is present ('if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there'), drawing holiness from Havayah in the S"G (63) expansion
tmp:1098: the state of having ascended to some rung of supernal holiness yet not resting there but striving ever higher — drawing holiness from the Name Ehyeh in the KS"A (161) expansion, 'expert in running' (baki be-ratzo)
tmp:1099: Numbers 20:8 'And you shall speak to the rock' — proof-verse mapped to the chotem (nose) in the third tikkun of the beard, the hidden full path beneath the nostrils
tmp:1100: simchah shel mitzvah — the joy of performing a commandment, the joyful state connected with verbal confession (viduy devarim) of one's sins
tmp:1104: the thought (machashavah) that one binds to speech in prayer — the mental component whose linkage to the spoken word forms the vessel of prayer
tmp:1105: the yod (letter/point) that is formed — the small point produced in constructing the aleph-vessel through binding thought to speech in the Jew's (tzaddik's) prayer
tmp:1106: 'Vayitzer' (Gen 2:7, spelled with two yods) — the double formation: for good and for evil, for reward and for punishment; the tzeirei vowel as judgment-and-mercy
tmp:1107: MaNTzePaKh — the five final-form letters (mem, nun, tzadi, peh, khaf) instituted by the 'seers' (prophets), symbolizing the veins (veridin) and 216/din, the aspect of judgment
tmp:1109: Zohar dictum 'break the chet of kaneh (reed)' — the letter-operation from Psalms 68:31 'Rebuke the beast of the reed', guarding the mind from turning chametz
tmp:1110: 'and make from it a heh' — transforming the broken chet into the letter heh, thereby turning the letters of chametz (leaven) into matzah: keeping wisdom unleavened
tmp:1111: the transformation whereby deliberate sins — here the alien/stray thoughts in prayer — are converted into merits (zedonot na'asin ke-zakhuyot) for one who rules in his prayer
tmp:1112: the deliverance, via breaking the chet into heh, from the aspect of chametz which is the 'side of death' (sitra de-mota) — escape from leavened, deadened intellect
tmp:1117: zahav — gold as symbol of zivvug (coupling/union), aroused from the left side/north ('From the north gold comes', Job 37:22; Zohar Vayeshev 186b)
tmp:1120: the pairing and combining of the Torah's letters (via the vowel-points) — symbolizing the couplings of bodies (zivvugei ha-gufot)
tmp:1121: zivvug ha-neshikin — the kabbalistic 'coupling of kisses', the mouth-to-mouth union effected by speech ('loosening the mouth of the mute'), preceding bodily union
tmp:1122: zivvuga de-Kudsha-Brikh-Hu u-Shekhinteh — the supernal union of the Holy One and His Shekhinah, effected by Israel's prayers, linked to the splitting of the Sea into twelve paths
tmp:1124: zivvuga di-kedushah — the holy marital union (as merited by Joseph, 'ben porat'), opposite of the serpent's union of the Sitra Achra, guarded by the eyes/tzitzit
tmp:1125: the pairing and combining of the nekudot (vowel-points) themselves — symbolizing the couplings of souls (as distinct from the letters = bodies)
tmp:1126: zivvugei ha-nefashot — the couplings/matings of souls, the soul-level unions symbolized by the combining of the vowel-points, whereby arriving souls bring stray or repentant thoughts
